general_information.address: Well, I’ve got the road part in my head, but the whole address all at once always gets muddled for me. It’s on Fallingbrook… somewhere in Toronto, I think. Or maybe you meant the mailing one? Could you say which part you want first?

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s mostly… waves of sadness, really, and missing my wife a lot since she died. That was about a year ago, from cancer, and some days it just hits me harder than others. I’m still working and getting through things, but at anniversaries I do cry more, and that sort of thing.
current_concerns.goals: I just want to figure out how to live with it, I guess. Keep going the way she would have wanted, and not feel so stuck in it all the time.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born in Cork, and we moved to Toronto when I was 8. It was a warm family, really—nothing too dramatic that I can think of.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I did an engineering degree, and honestly I don’t remember any significant difficulties from then.
personal_history.significant_relationships: Well… I was married, and now I’m widowed. We were together for 33 years, and my wife died about a year ago.
personal_history.future_goals: I’d like to keep working, see my grandchildren, and maybe travel a little.
